articles.summary: FINNY for Enterprise Teams enables personalized, AI-powered growth at scale across hundreds of advisors NEW YORK – June 9, 2026 – FINNY Inc. ("FINNY"), the AI-powered prospecting and marketing platform built specifically for financial advisors, today announced the launch of FINNY for Enterprise Teams.
articles.title: FINNY Launches Enterprise Growth Platform With Mercer Advisors as Flagship User
